revision_note: Revision 1 concluded the asserted calibration was NOT reproducible. That conclusion was an artifact of the same defect under investigation: the harness defaulted to the wrong receptor. With the correct LpxC structure the claim reproduces. Corrected here.

root_cause.finding: THE HARNESS WAS DOCKING INTO THE WRONG PROTEIN.
root_cause.detail: run_autodock_vina() defaulted to receptor 3TYZ_chainA_receptor.pdbqt and labelled every result 'UDP-3-O-acyl-GlcNAc Deacetylase (LpxC)'. 3TYZ is NOT LpxC — its PDB title reads 'CRYSTAL STRUCTURE OF THE YERSINIA PESTIS DIHYDROPTEROATE SYNTHETASE WITH SUBSTRATE TRANSITION STATE COMPLEX' (DHPS). CHIR-090 is an LpxC inhibitor, so it was being docked into an unrelated enzyme, scoring -3.05 kcal/mol.
root_cause.evidence: The committed pose CHIR-090_docked_LpxC.pdbqt has centroid (-7.596,-12.254,21.051), which matches the co-crystal CHIR-090 (C90) site in 5U39 at (-8.13,-13.52,21.16) to ~1.5 A — confirming the original work used 5U39, and only the harness default was wrong.
root_cause.corroboration: TRM-ABX-219_docked_DHPS.pdbqt exists (-5.683 kcal/mol), showing the DHPS docking was performed knowingly and separately.

positive_control_validation.method: Redock CHIR-090 into its OWN co-crystal structure. receptor 5U39_receptor.pdbqt (P. aeruginosa LpxC + Zn, ligand and waters stripped, metal retained); box derived from co-crystal ligand C90, chain A
positive_control_validation.acceptance_criterion: RMSD <= 2.0 A reproduces the crystallographic binding mode
positive_control_validation.result: PASS — both the score (-10.17 vs claimed -10.1) and the pose reproduce

5U39_receptor.pdbqt.title: PSEUDOMONAS AERUGINOSA LPXC IN COMPLEX WITH CHIR-090

3TYZ_chainA_receptor.pdbqt.title: CRYSTAL STRUCTURE OF THE YERSINIA PESTIS DIHYDROPTEROATE SYNTHETASE WITH SUBSTRATE TRANSITION STATE COMPLEX
3TYZ_chainA_receptor.pdbqt.cocrystal_ligand: XHP (two copies: chain A resseq 278 and chain B resseq 278)
3TYZ_chainA_receptor.pdbqt.metal: Mg present in source, stripped from the prepared receptor (0 HETATM retained)
3TYZ_chainA_receptor.pdbqt.status: NOT LpxC — invalid for LpxC inhibitors. Retained for DHPS work only.

current_results_5U39_validated.role: positive control — strongest binder, as expected

notes_on_interpreting_these_numbers: A rigid-receptor Vina score is NOT a dissociation constant. The kd_nm values are a thermodynamic conversion of the docking score and must not be quoted as measured affinity.
The -9.09 kcal/mol in commit c1f55d1 refers to hydroxamate ANALOGS (H1-H5), not to TRM-ABX-219 itself.
TRM-ABX-219's earlier committed pose recorded -8.252 kcal/mol; the validated re-run gives -8.21. Consistent.
TRM-ABX-220 has no structure on record; the benchmark docks TRM-ABX-219-H1.pdbqt under the name TRM-ABX-220. That substitution must be resolved before any ABX-220 number is used.
The CRUZA-LEAD-01 and KRAS-PEP-G12D entries are SYNTHETIC_HEURISTIC_TEST_VECTOR, not empirical.
remediation_applied: RECEPTORS registry added: receptor -> true target, source PDB, co-crystal ligand, metal, validated flag
DEFAULT_RECEPTOR is now 5U39_receptor.pdbqt (validated LpxC); target label is taken from the registry, no longer hardcoded
Search box derived from the receptor's co-crystal ligand via derive_box_from_crystal_ligand(), with mandatory chain filtering
Fabricated empirical fallback (-10.1 / -9.09) removed from run_autodock_vina()
Benchmark survives offline federation nodes instead of aborting before writing its report
self_healing_verification derived from measured traces rather than asserted
